description: Change a team member's role. The last owner cannot be demoted. Needs an API key sent as x-api-key that holds the team:admin scope, made by someone who is still an owner or admin of the workspace; a token or any other key is refused. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

user_id.description: The person's user id: user_id on a list_team_members result.

name: change_team_member_role
